propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission and ingestion boundaries via port calls
Remaining Jira modules (outbound_fields, adf, acli, comment_limits, probe mechanics, rich-text codecs) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims or reach-through
All package-root reconciler modules must have zero imports of adapters.jira or lazy-key literals to adapters/jira, except inbound_fields.py pending relocation
Outbound and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission

Backend selection and routing must occur exclusively through config.reconciler.backend registry and port calls, with all transport construction sites and provider literals moved off direct vendor paths
